title: Workflow execution contract
description: The frozen plan for one workflow run (AUDIT-0002 remediation R12). Declares, before work begins, which resources a workflow requires and what evidence would prove each ran. After freezing, a requirement may not be weakened, removed, or reclassified; changes require an amendment that preserves the original.

workflow.description: The operator-facing outcome workflow this run belongs to.

scope.description: The bounded point-A-to-point-B range agreed with the operator. A workflow with no bounded scope cannot stop.

state.description: Lifecycle position. Work may only begin at 'frozen'.

required_outputs.description: Repository-relative paths the run must produce.

approval_boundaries.description: Points at which the workflow must stop and ask, such as drifting outside the agreed scope.

frozen_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical contract with volatile freeze fields cleared, so the hash covers the plan rather than the act of recording it.

resource_id.description: Canonical id: an exact subagent_type, skill name, command, or backend invocation.

execution_mode.description: Determines which observations count. An artifact never proves an invocation, and general-purpose never satisfies a named specialist.

evidence_rule.description: What would prove this requirement ran.

failure_policy.description: warn_only is illegal on a required requirement: a required step that can be skipped silently is not a requirement.

applicability_rule.description: Required on conditional requirements. Without it, not_applicable cannot be justified.

not_applicable_reason.description: Preserved when a conditional requirement is discharged as not applicable.

approved_by.description: Renewed operator approval. An amendment is not self-authorising.
